assets.layout: 4 columns x 3 rows; alpha island sprite rectangles with explicit face anchors and nine-slice borders
assets.prompt: Create a production Unity mobile-game UI SPRITE ATLAS, using the attached image as the strict style reference, NOT as an image to reproduce as a screenshot. Landscape 4:3 canvas, clean transparent background. Exactly 12 separate sprites, perfectly arranged in an equal 4 COLUMN by 3 ROW GRID, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each sprite fits comfortably inside its own cell with 12% transparent padding and no crossing grid boundaries. No labels, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no checkerboard baked in. Match the reference's charming illustrated 2.5D matte mobile puzzle look: warm cream faces #FFF0D0, broad soft dark plum rims #603B55, very shallow peach bevel, short soft lower shadow. Front/top facing UI; absolutely no thick black platform, no glossy gold frames, no photoreal plastic. ROW 1: (1) BLANK horizontally oriented rounded cream information plaque, dark plum rim, about 1.6:1 aspect; (2) BLANK rounded square cream booster button base, dark plum rim, shallow small shadow; (3) standalone chunky yellow-orange curved undo arrow facing upper-left, like reference bottom-left, no button behind it; (4) standalone blue cube and red cube with two dark plum curved swapping arrows above and below, no button behind. ROW 2: (5) standalone mint-teal miniature conveyor with three small cream rollers and a small plum circular PLUS emblem at upper-right; (6) standalone shallow empty peach wooden tray with a small plum circular PLUS emblem at upper-right; (7) standalone simple chunky dark plum gear with transparent center hole, flat matte; (8) standalone orange-yellow wrapped present with red ribbon and red bow. ROW 3: (9) BLANK bright leaf-green circular quantity badge with thin cream outer border, no number; (10) standalone dark plum rounded X close icon; (11) BLANK square cream modal panel with dark plum border, subtle peach inset, spacious completely plain cream center for text, same visual treatment as the square booster base; (12) BLANK mint-green square selected navigation tile with dark plum rim and cream thin inset border. Consistent lighting from upper-left, no hard long shadows. The sprites must be clear and legible at small mobile UI scale. Only these 12 isolated sprites.

Create ONE production background texture for a portrait 9:16 mobile puzzle game, closely matching ONLY the environment background of this reference. Remove / omit ALL game objects, conveyors, tracks, blocks, trays, UI buttons, text, counters, icons and logos. The game will draw those separately. Desired image: front-facing orthographic top-down warmly illustrated 2.5D board. Dark muted plum purple full-bleed background #452139. Uppermost 10 percent and lowermost 14 percent are calm plain plum for overlay interface. In the remaining central area from y=11% to y=86%, a large golden-orange tile-floor island fills almost the entire width, with irregular gently stepped rounded puzzle-like perimeter, surrounded by a broad muted purple raised rim. Large subtle alternating orange/yellow square tiles, very low contrast (not distracting), a few small orange pill-shaped floor marks. Floor mostly unobstructed and plain, ideal behind dynamically placed puzzle pieces. Shallow peach/amber edge highlight, soft plum lower depth shadow; not glossy, not metallic, not photorealistic. At far side edges only add a few rounded muted mauve square stone tiles to reproduce the reference's charm; keep them outside the playable center. Soft upper-left light, simple clean forms, crisp color blocks, friendly casual game illustration, no busy grain/no heavy vignette. Frame aligns with the screen, symmetrical overall, no isometric skew. Keep center blank; absolutely no conveyor or UI baked into background.

Each icon centered in its EXACT grid cell, wholly within central 76 percent with generous transparent gutters. All symbols legible at small sizes, polished consistent casual game art. NO LETTERS, NO WORDS, NO NUMBERS, NO BACKGROUND PANELS. Cells left-to-right, top-to-bottom: row1: orange curved undo arrow; two blue/red cubes with plum swap arrows; mint miniature conveyor with plum plus badge; cream empty cargo tray with plum plus badge; plum gear; plum X close symbol. Row2: gold coin embossed star; coral heart; friendly toy avatar head; cream plus sign inside plum circle; plum information i symbol; orange gift with coral bow. Row3: cream speaker with plum sound waves; plum music note; plum vibrating smartphone; orange shop bag; mint globe landmark map; cream house with plum roof. Row4: gold trophy; three colorful friendly toy heads; cream calendar with mint tick; mint circular badge with CREAM CHECKMARK (this check must have round green background); mint plain circular inventory badge with cream border and EMPTY center; coral cracked heart. Row5: a curtain over a cream cargo tray; dark plum mystery block with cream question mark; two mint conveyor portal arches; orange striped barrier over tray; translucent mint ice around blue cargo; a LARGE gold padlock on slatted cream gate with orange key. Row6: cream tray wrapped THREE TIMES with thick golden rope; rolled mint carpet covering trays; completely blue colored cargo tray with matching cubes; cream block dispenser with mint doors; two cubes connected by chunky brass screw; small blue/red/yellow/green cubes grouped. Important atlas geometry: precisely 6 equal columns and 6 equal rows, no labels, no merges, no decorative elements crossing cells. Real transparent alpha behind sprites.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production Unity UI panel sprite atlas. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows of equal SQUARE cells on a transparent background, 12 independent blank panels. Square canvas arranged 4:3 overall aspect preferred. Each panel centered, occupies 88 percent of its cell, 6 percent transparent margin on every side. All panels front facing orthographic, NOT isometric. Cozy casual toy puzzle UI style, soft matte surfaces, chunky plum raised beveled border, warm upper-left highlight, subtle short lower-right plum drop shadow, clear flat unmarked center suitable for text. Palette cream #FFF0D0, plum #49263E, plum rim #6B405A, warm caramel #C88D65, mint #61C7B4, amber #FFB83E, coral #FF625E. Rows from left to right: row1 (1) cream rounded-square button inside thick plum beveled surround, (2) mint green rounded-square primary button inside thick plum surround, (3) coral rounded-square button inside plum surround, (4) golden amber rounded-square button inside plum surround. Row2 (5) large cream rounded rectangle window with thick plum frame (still inside one square cell, square proportions, blank spacious center), (6) plum rounded title plaque with thin caramel edge and blank plum center, (7) pale parchment cream inset card, delicate caramel bevel, rounded corners, (8) soft dark plum rounded-square recessed inset panel with subtle purple rim. Row3 (9) cream rounded-square booster button thick plum rim and caramel lower edge, (10) muted dusty mauve disabled rounded-square booster button, (11) mint selected navigation rounded panel with cream bevel, (12) low cream oval price lozenge with caramel edge (wider than tall within its cell). Corner radii about 18 percent of panel width, straight edges and especially entire central 55 percent must be uniform flat color for 9-slicing. NO WORDS, NO SYMBOLS, NO ICONS, NO EXTRA ORNAMENTS, NO WATERMARKS, no strokes between cells. Real transparent alpha around the 12 isolated blank panels.

assets.layout: 2 columns x 2 rows; gameplay ground and New York/London/Paris home backgrounds
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a SINGLE Unity mobile puzzle environment background atlas with EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, FOUR separate portrait backgrounds touching edge-to-edge, canvas portrait 1024x1536 or 1536x2048. No text, no UI, no frames between cells. Four equally sized rectangular quadrants. Style throughout: polished casual mobile puzzle toy world, matte rounded block shapes, very soft bevels, simple chunky diorama geometry, upper-left sunlight, gentle lower-right shadows, warm orange amber tiled ground, cream props, mint teal foliage and structures, dark plum edges/vignette. Do not include conveyor tracks, cargo trays, buttons, counters or floating icons; gameplay objects will be added by Unity.
TOP LEFT QUADRANT is a nearly flat TOP-DOWN gameplay backdrop: warm golden orange checker tiles (#FFB83E/#FFAB36) in broad subtle large squares filling the central 85%, scattered very small amber flecks, stair-stepped dark plum stone boundary only near outer 5% edges, a few mauve rounded stones in corners. Center MUST be open unmarked tiled ground, evenly lit with no buildings, no track, no central object. Strong dark plum outer edge.
TOP RIGHT QUADRANT is a warm playful NEW YORK toy city home background: a tiny rounded mint Statue of Liberty and cream skyscraper silhouettes near upper third and right edge, amber tiled plaza spacious center, a few toy shrubs on edges, broad dark plum silhouette foreground. Center-lower area kept simple for overlaid play button.
BOTTOM LEFT QUADRANT is LONDON toy city home background: mint/cream Big Ben and small bridge near upper third, warm amber plaza, plum rounded borders and sparse mint shrubs, open center-lower ground.
BOTTOM RIGHT QUADRANT is PARIS toy city home background: chunky small cream and caramel Eiffel Tower near upper third, mint rounded trees at edges, amber tiled plaza open center-lower, plum border. All 4 scenes in same harmonious palette and toy matte style, simplified clean visual hierarchy. Exactly 2x2 equally sized quadrant arrangement, no writing whatsoever.

packing: Original generated PNG alpha is preserved. Tools/import_theme.py reads alpha bounds and writes normalized Sprite.Create rectangles, without editing bitmap pixels.

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the current 4-column by 3-row Unity UI panel atlas. Image 2 is ONLY the user's style reference, showing the UI view they want changed. Edit Image 1 into a completely TOP-DOWN / FACE-ON orthographic panel atlas. The key requested change is to REMOVE EVERY DARK PLUM / BLACK LOWER PEDESTAL, lower step, extruded side wall and thick offset base from ALL twelve panels. Those lower plinths must be replaced with genuine transparency, not recolored and not hidden behind a new frame.
Keep cozy cream, caramel, mint, coral, amber and plum palette, tasteful soft ceramic bevels. Make each panel a SINGLE centered thin tile seen straight-on, with the top and bottom edges geometrically SYMMETRIC and matching rim thickness. Thin cream raised outline, fine caramel inner bevel, uniform broad flat center. Only a tiny diffuse shadow around the edge, at most 2% of tile height. No visible side planes, no isometric perspective, no thick stacked layers, no large downward shadows. Shallow bevel highlights give a gentle floating feel. Matte clean surfaces, no glossy streaks. This must be visibly slimmer and more centered than the input. Centers are empty to receive live text/icons.
Production transparent sprite sheet, exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, 12 separate blank panels, canvas landscape 4:3, ideally 2048x1536. Each panel occupies at most 80% of its own cell with generous transparent gutters on EVERY side. Do not let any tile or shadow cross a grid cell boundary. Keep the original functional cell order, but recenter every tile after removing its bottom step. Faces upright and level. 9-slice-ready: straight horizontal/vertical edge strips, smooth rounded corners, clean uniform central 60%; lighting stays in the slim rim. Clean antialiased alpha edges without white flecks or colored fringes.
Cell order left-to-right/top-to-bottom:
Row1: 1 cream general rounded-square button with slim cream/caramel border; 2 mint primary rounded-square button same slim border; 3 coral red button same border; 4 golden amber button same border.
Row2: 5 cream spacious rounded-square window frame with very thin caramel bevel, no pedestal; 6 deep PLUM title plaque in a thin cream/caramel frame, wide rectangle about 1.45:1 INSIDE its own cell, dark face remains but NO lower dark base; 7 pale cream inset paper card with fine caramel rim; 8 deep PLUM recessed settings panel with a thin mauve/plum rim, no offset base.
Row3: 9 cream booster square with a shallow cream/caramel bevel; 10 dusty mauve disabled booster square same thin geometry; 11 mint selected-navigation tile with a slim cream border; 12 horizontal cream oval price lozenge with fine caramel rim.
Preserve all twelve identities. NO WORDS, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO GIFTS OR OTHER ICONS, no grid lines, no screenshot scene background. Do not reproduce the gift or tree from image 2: it is just style context. Entire background outside the 12 isolated panels must be truly transparent.

assets.layout: 6 columns x 6 rows; 36 icons including 11 mechanism illustrations
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a BRAND NEW premium sculpted 3D mobile puzzle game icon atlas, 6 columns x 6 rows, all 36 separate icons as specified below. Square canvas 2048x2048, genuine transparent alpha. This must look newly art-directed rather than like flat pictograms or generic glossy sticker icons. Beautiful tangible miniature TOYS, rounded ceramic bodies, soft satin resin, clearly extruded beveled geometry. Consistent 3/4 top-front product perspective for objects and nearly front-facing functional symbols, warm upper-left studio key light, subtle cool teal fill, compact dense contact shadows under overlapping parts. Cream/caramel rims, deep plum supporting sides, vivid blue/coral/mint/amber faces. Friendly tactile material with clean sculpted surfaces, no grain or glints. LARGE well-defined volume and richer depth, not greasy specular. Shape hierarchy: thick readable central subject, restrained accents, clear silhouette at tiny sizes.
Strict atlas engineering: EXACTLY 6 equal columns x 6 equal rows, one centered independent icon each; each fits within central 78% of its cell with transparent gutters on all sides. No overlap between cells. No background tiles, no checkerboard, no colored halos, no shadows entering adjacent cells. Readable at 48 pixels. All 36 functions MUST remain correct, no duplicates or omissions.
Exact rows left-to-right:
1) broad gold CURVED UNDO ARROW with visibly sculpted caramel underside; two substantial BLUE and CORAL CUBES with PLUM swap arrows; little MINT CONVEYOR with cream rollers and PLUM circle PLUS badge; sculpted CREAM EMPTY CARGO TRAY with PLUM circle PLUS badge; thick PLUM GEAR with CREAM inner hole; thick PLUM X.
2) beveled AMBER COIN with raised STAR and caramel edge; puffy sculpted CORAL HEART; FRIENDLY toy worker head with MINT cap and CREAM brim; raised CREAM PLUS in thick PLUM round medallion; CREAM information lowercase i in thick PLUM round medallion; AMBER gift box with CORAL ribbon/bow.
3) CREAM speaker with PLUM sound waves; dimensional PLUM MUSIC NOTE; vibrating PLUM PHONE with CREAM screen; AMBER SHOPPING BAG with CREAM handles; MINT GLOBE with raised CREAM latitude bands; CREAM HOUSE with deep PLUM roof.
4) AMBER TROPHY with PLUM pedestal; three friendly little toy heads; CREAM CALENDAR with MINT tick; raised CREAM CHECKMARK ON FULL MINT GREEN CIRCULAR BACKGROUND; completely BLANK MINT CIRCULAR BADGE with CREAM rim (no symbol, no numeral); split CORAL BROKEN HEART.
5) a colored CURTAIN covering CREAM CARGO TRAY; sculpted PLUM MYSTERY BLOCK with big CREAM QUESTION MARK; TWO MINT PORTAL ARCHES standing on miniature conveyors; AMBER STRIPED BARRIER across CREAM CARGO TRAY; BLUE CARGO encased in pale MINT translucent ICE; a LARGE AMBER PADLOCK over CREAM SLATTED GARAGE DOOR with a matching chunky KEY.
6) CREAM CARGO TRAY wrapped THREE TIMES in thick golden ROPE; thick rolled MINT CARPET covering a CREAM TRAY; ALL-BLUE CARGO TRAY with matching BLUE BLOCKS; CREAM REFILL DISPENSER with MINT DOORS and a BLUE BLOCK; one BLUE and one CORAL BLOCK joined by big golden SCREW; group of four separate BLUE/CORAL/YELLOW/GREEN toy CUBES.
No text except functional question mark and lowercase i. No dark outline strokes. Keep genuine alpha and keep the green completion badge and blank inventory badge correct. A cohesive premium toy-workshop visual collection.

assets.layout: 2 columns x 2 rows; gameplay, New York, London, Paris
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. EDIT TARGET: supplied 2x2 Unity background atlas. Keep EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS by TWO ROWS of equal portrait backgrounds, all four quadrant boundaries and meanings unchanged. Portrait atlas aspect 2:3, ideally 1536x2304. Four scenes fill their cells fully, opaque, without visible separators or frames at the internal boundaries. Upgrade to premium sculpted miniature toy-diorama game art matching cream porcelain, satin mint resin, warm caramel details, golden amber tiled ground and deep plum sculpted stone edges. More refined geometry, convincing bevels, soft warm upper-left sunlight, gentle global illumination, beautiful contact occlusion, subtle aerial depth in city skylines, smooth clean surfaces and coherent material finish. Rich but controlled color, premium polished casual puzzle art, no noisy microdetail, no overly shiny plastic or glare.
TOP LEFT: flat overhead GAMEPLAY GROUND. Central 85% must remain calm, open golden amber checker tiles in broad low-contrast squares; no central shadows or objects. Thick sculpted plum/mauve stone boundary only at extreme outer edges and corners, sparse rounded mint shrubs and small caramel stones on edges. Gameplay pieces added separately; keep this ground very quiet and readable.
TOP RIGHT: NEW YORK miniature city. Mint Statue of Liberty with cream/caramel plinth and cream rounded skyscrapers clustered in upper third and along outer right edge, amber tiled plaza with broad clean open lower-middle area for play button. Small mint tree accents and plum foreground edge stones, no central clutter.
BOTTOM LEFT: LONDON. Cream/caramel Big Ben, small toy bridge over restrained teal water in upper third; rounded mint tree clusters near edges, spacious amber tiled lower-middle plaza, sculpted plum foreground stones.
BOTTOM RIGHT: PARIS. Small elegant chunky cream/caramel Eiffel Tower in upper third, cream distant toy city with soft atmospheric depth, rounded mint trees at edges, clean broad amber tiled lower-middle plaza and plum stone foreground.
Preserve original UI-safe compositions: city landmarks above middle, center-lower clear for buttons. NO TEXT, no words, no UI elements, no coins, no floating decorations, no tracks, no vehicles, no cargo trays. Each quadrant stays a distinct full portrait scene. All four use consistent camera/material/lighting.
